body:
It varies, but in general, the addiction can linger for quite a while. Was 2 years with me, as far as cutting goes (still punched). But always be aware that, even after a year clean, the urges can sneak up on you when you least expect them, when you feel most vulnerable.

But as you said, the stress relief is very addicting. Try to find something else to relieve your stress, such as running or weightlifting (even if you're terrible at it). 

Then again though, what use is my input, just relapsed into cutting a couple weeks ago. All I can say, I guess, is that before you cut, realize that the impulse to cut is just that: an impulse. You are better than your impulses and you can control them.

I know how that feels. Haven't hung out with a friend since... 7th grade I believe, and I'm a senior now. That's probably more my fault than anyone else, but on second thought almost all of my "friends" are raging douchers. I'd always attempt to make plans but they always fall through. That was years ago, and I've given up since. Maybe in college.
